title: Version 2.1.146
description: Renamed /simplify to /code-review with optional effort level, auto mode no longer suppresses AskUserQuestion, fixed Windows PowerShell tool issues, improved auto-updater reliability with network failure retries, and improved diff rendering performance for large files.

title: Version 2.1.145
description: Added claude agents --json for scripting, agent_id tracking in OTEL spans, plugin discover screens show commands/agents/skills before installation, and fixed various issues with MCP prompts, spinner freezes, and cross-project resume hints.

title: Version 2.1.144
description: Added /resume support for background sessions, elapsed duration to subagent completion notifications, and plugin browse panes now show last update time. Fixed startup hanging when api.anthropic.com is unreachable, improved terminal rendering glitches in VS Code, and numerous bug fixes.

title: Version 2.1.143
description: Added plugin dependency enforcement with disable-chain hints, projected context cost to plugin browse pane, and worktree.bgIsolation setting. PowerShell tool now passes -ExecutionPolicy Bypass on Windows. Fixed multiple issues with background sessions and macOS Full Disk Access.

title: Version 2.1.142
description: Added new claude agents flags for configuring dispatched sessions. Fast mode now uses Opus 4.7 by default. Fixed MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT for remote HTTP/SSE servers, background session worktree recognition, and daemon reconnection after macOS sleep/wake.

title: Version 2.1.141
description: Added terminalSequence field to hooks for desktop notifications, CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS for GitHub plugin cloning, and claude agents --cwd flag. Improved spinner feedback during long thinking periods and plugin menu navigation. Fixed numerous issues with background side-queries, model selection, and permission prompts.

title: Version 2.1.140
description: Improved Agent tool subagent_type matching to accept case- and separator-insensitive values, updated agent color palette, and fixed issues with /goal hanging silently and settings hot-reload with symlinked files.

title: Version 2.1.139
description: Added agent view (Research Preview), /goal command for completion conditions, /scroll-speed command, and claude plugin details. Added transcript view navigation shortcuts. Fixed deadlock with expired credentials and numerous other issues.
